title: Maternal Referral Status
description: A reusable schema for representing the status and outcome of a de-identified referral within a maternal-care journey.

referral_id.description: Unique de-identified identifier for the referral.

journey_id.description: Pseudonymous or synthetic identifier linking the referral to a maternal-care journey.

referral_type.description: General type of service or handoff required.

created_time.description: Date and time the referral was created.

scheduled_time.description: Scheduled referral appointment or handoff time, when applicable.

completed_time.description: Date and time the referral was completed, when applicable.

destination_type.description: General destination category without identifying a specific provider.

service_available.description: Whether the required service was available at the intended destination.

accepted_by_destination.description: Whether the destination accepted the referral.

patient_attended.description: Whether the patient attended or completed the referred care step.

follow_up_required.description: Indicates whether further follow-up is required after this referral event.

region.description: Optional broad implementation region such as a state or district.
